title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: We are hiring a Senior Frontend Developer with 4+ years of experience specialising in React and modern JavaScript. You will lead the frontend development of our SaaS product, build reusable component libraries, and ensure high performance and responsiveness across all devices. Experience with TypeScript, Next.js, and Redux is strongly preferred.
responsibilities: Lead frontend development of the core SaaS product
Build and maintain a reusable React component library
Optimize application performance and page load times
Implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma designs
requirements: Deep understanding of JavaScript ES6+ and CSS
Experience with state management (Redux or Context API)
Strong understanding of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
